people-ops-bot: TR-5234 updated: shuttle confirmed 12:20pm Terminal 1 arrivals; hotel HL-55890 reserved.

Lena (recruiter): Noted and added to invite. I'll text candidate morning-of with shuttle ETA and meeting point.
